title: Will President Trump sign a law called Trumpcare before his term ends?
resolution_criteria: YES if, before his presidential term ends at noon on January 20, 2029, Donald Trump signs into law a health-care bill whose official or short title contains the word 'Trumpcare', or which he or the White House officially names 'Trumpcare' when signing it. Health-care bills that only the press or opponents call 'Trumpcare', executive orders, and campaign plans that are not enacted do not count; otherwise NO. Decided by the responsible body's own published record (an official announcement, filing, vote, opinion or data release). Resolves YES as soon as the event is recorded as having happened on or before 2029-01-20; otherwise NO on 2029-01-20.
